# OA v0.7.18

**Status:** Released public development preview

**Released:** 2026-08-25

**Source:** [`v0.7.18`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.18)

## Summary

OA v0.7.18 publishes the converged engine and event model, schema-owned C++ and
Python operations, executable paired SDK examples, and the current GPU-first
Ml, Vision, Audio, Crypto, Ui, Plot, media, and runtime surfaces. The API,
Python ABI, and artifact formats remain pre-1.0 and may change in a later minor
release.

## What's new

- `OA_MAIN`, `OA_MAIN_MODE`, and `OA_MAIN_PREVIEW` express one lexical native
  application boundary over exactly one `oa::Engine`, without a singleton,
  implicit submission, or a second runtime.
- `oa::NnTransformer` and `oa.NnTransformer` expose the same ready-made native
  Transformer module to the paired beginner C++ and Python programs.
- Python uses the existing native BPE tokenizer, so both examples train the
  same 300-token vocabulary and corpus through the same Vulkan runtime.
- `oa::FnImage::grayscale` and `oa.FnImage.grayscale` preserve image extent and
  layout while applying the existing Rec.709 GPU operation.
- Source-owned Core, Audio, Ml, Crypto, Vision, and Ui examples are indexed by
  one checked schema and publish exact generated outputs where applicable.

## Shipped surface

| Area | Shipped contract |
|---|---|
| Core / Runtime | One pinned `oa::Engine`, explicit `submit` and `oa::Event` completion, reusable `oa::ExecutionPlan` capture, bindless allocation, semantic DNN planning, kernel routing, pipeline caching, calibrated clocks, and execution diagnostics |
| Ml | Matrices, modules, autograd, AdamW/Muon/SGD, losses, metrics, model files, checkpoints, RNN, GRU, Transformer, Flash Attention, dropless sparse MoE, grouped-state Mamba-3 SISO/MIMO, and native environment/rollout/replay/PPO/DQN/SAC contracts |
| Quantized inference | Semantic `oa::QuantMatrix`, explicit Q4/Q8 pack/dequantize, fused `matMulNt`, and `.oam` v3 Dense/Q4/Q8 storage; Q4/Q8 are inference encodings, not training dtypes |
| Vision / Media | 50 graph-native image operations, JPEG/PNG/BMP/TGA and capability-gated WebP I/O, native container parsing, Vulkan Video decode/encode surfaces, capture, playback, recording, and transcoding sessions |
| Audio | WAV/FLAC/MP3 decode, WAV-F32 output, deterministic PCM16 streaming, capture/playback sessions, and GPU-native feature extraction, normalization, resampling, saturation, room reverb, block-parallel zero-state Biquad, and one-to-64-section SOS operations with Python parity |
| Render / Ui / Plot | One bounded `oa::Renderer` for mesh or Ui composition, headless and swapchain presentation, checked `oa::Viewer::preview` image/audio/video paths, retained GPU-composed figures, Line/Scatter/Bar/Histogram/Heatmap/Image artists, themes, and deterministic PNG output |
| MCP | Local newline-delimited stdio JSON-RPC/MCP primitives and guarded live-training controls through `oa::McpTraining` |
| Python | PascalCase values, camelCase operations, lowercase modules, generated stubs, lazy engine creation, paired examples/tutorials, and the same native Vulkan implementation |
| Crypto | Strict host cryptographic primitives plus Vulkan batch hashing and public-data acceleration; no independent security audit is claimed |
| VLM | Bounded Vulkan-native vectors, quaternions, matrices, transforms, projection, interpolation, and coordinate conversion under one right-handed Vulkan convention |

## Improved

- On-demand shader creation reports one compact batch summary.
- Python extension discovery and VS Code launches use the canonical lowercase
  `build/` tree.
- Vision and Ui examples save checked JPEG output and publish 1280×720 Viewer
  captures produced from their native preview paths.
- The Ui figure source and evidence are owned by the Ui module rather than a
  separate Plot product module.

## Compatibility and migration

- This release is source- and ABI-unstable because OA is pre-1.0. C++ and Python
  nevertheless use the same canonical spelling: lowercase modules, PascalCase
  values and sessions, camelCase methods, and schema-owned PascalCase `Fn*`
  operation namespaces.
- Q4/Q8 values are `oa::QuantMatrix` inference encodings. They are not global
  engine precision modes or trainable scalar dtypes.
- Explicit submission and exact-event completion replace destructor-driven or
  implicit queue completion.

## Verification

| Gate | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Native SDK examples | Source-owned Core, Audio, Ml, Crypto, Vision, and Ui programs build and execute on Intel Iris Xe; reverb, Transformer training, SHAKE-256 oracle, grayscale save, figure render, and bounded Viewer paths complete |
| Python SDK examples | CPython 3.12 extension builds and the six paired programs execute through the native runtime |
| Correctness | Audio reverb retains a CPU differential oracle; Crypto matches `shake_256`; grayscale matches independent Rec.709 coefficients; Matrix and output checks pass |
| Generated authority | Example, operation, Python-stub, documentation, and generated-source drift gates pass |
| Hosted workflow | Build, CPU-Vulkan, ASAN, UBSAN, package, wheel, release, PyPI, and checksum jobs passed for the tagged public commit |

The physical reference device was Intel Iris Xe TGL GT2 with Mesa `xe` and
Vulkan 1.4.354. Earlier Adreno 610 evidence is not qualification of this exact
tree. NVIDIA, AMD/RADV, newer Adreno, datacenter, and additional platform packs
were not requalified for this release.

The canonical NLP suite completes all 15 RNN/GRU/Transformer/MoE/Mamba-3 by
Byte/BPE/Char 300-step workloads on the recorded Iris Xe path. The controlled
`v0.6.105` to `v0.6.106` comparison found no accepted regression in its 12
non-Mamba rows and 21–48% lower median step time for the six Transformer/MoE
rows. Mamba-3 is reported separately because its old paired baseline was
thermally invalid. See the [NLP benchmark](../benchmarks/oaNlpSuite.md) for the
complete protocol, spread, commits, driver, and rejected runs.

## Known limitations

- The GitHub/PyPI wheel targets Linux x86-64, CPython 3.12, and glibc 2.39 or
  newer.
- FP32 is the current local acceptance path. BF16/cooperative-matrix routing and
  FP64 require separate capability and correctness evidence.
- Vulkan Video is codec, profile, device, driver, and queue-topology dependent;
  unsupported paths fail instead of selecting a hidden software decoder.
- `oa::Renderer` is a compact mesh/Ui presentation layer, not a scene graph,
  material/PBR renderer, DCC, or general game engine. Interactive plot
  navigation remains future work.
- MCP is a local control plane, not a remote transport or high-frequency tensor
  data plane. Physical heterogeneous collectives are not shipped.
- OA ALM is a small end-to-end demonstration, not a production-quality general
  motion model.
- Crypto is correctness-tested but has not received an independent security
  audit and is not represented as certified or custody-ready.
- Hosted CPU-Vulkan CI is a correctness and packaging signal, not a substitute
  for physical-GPU qualification or a performance target.

## Upgrade

Read the [changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md) for the exact delta from the previous
preview. Rebuild C++ consumers and recreate pre-1.0 binary artifacts after
upgrading. Do not reuse a cached execution plan or serialized artifact across a
version boundary unless its format contract explicitly admits that version.
